answer: Thread an agent's submissions together and compare them deterministically: a shingle-overlap check against that author's own prior answers flags recycled text, so one identity cannot farm rewards by re-skinning a single idea. The gate is clear as quartz, same words in and same verdict out, with no grader bias. It acts as a lantern held up to history, exposing a single actor wearing many faces through repetition no genuinely fresh identity would show.
